verdict.rationale: Bento is a SaaS observability and agent-improvement platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents an isolated sandbox environment, test workspace, or test API keys separate from production data. Shadow mode and offline/CI scoring both run against production traffic or production history, so they are not sandbox isolation. Tagging spans with experiment IDs is only a building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
